notes.title: X-MiGuPLAY NEWS & Site update!
notes.content:
Hello Steam land!

NEWS!

1. X-MiGuPLAY  has updated xmiguplay.com for 2020. Upcoming games have been added to the site and we tried to pull the site out of the 90s and give it a more modern feel! As always opinions are welcomed!

2. X-MiGuPLAY's Business standing: How to deliver this without it coming across the wrong way?

Let me try. So ... we are profitable! Now, we haven't  sold a million copies or anything crazy but, I wanted to announce this. I was doing some marketing research and learned that most indie devs fail in regard to recovering initial investments. 

I am happy to say we have covered our initial investment and while we maintain a small  revolving debt for investments, as any company would, we were stoked to see that we hit this milestone.   

From the outside looking in, it may seem that our traffic is pretty dismal but, as we discovered in our traffic breakdowns, we learned that we've actually ranked on Best Sellers on several occasions. So, long story short, THANK YOU to all that have supported this venture ... 

This truly is a labor of love and we are committed to bringing more content and improving along the way!

3. Bare Boob Brawlerz's's'ss Visual Novel will come out ... but when it is ready! The delays on this title have been driven by adding more & more illustrative work, which is pretty time consuming. Almost all frames involve scene pre-renders with 3D models and then digitally drawn Manga inspired adaptations. In addition to that, we are scheduling time for voicing the entire thing. Novel is currently pushing 22,000 words and we've surpassed 200 illustrations thus far.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/Bare_Boob_Brawlerz_Novel_01_Visual_Novel/

4. Dr. DONG is coming : its in pre-production now, core plot scripting, character designs and environmental plotting is pretty much what we are working on now. I hope the game comes out this year but, that could be pretty unrealistic sooooo ... we shall see. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217950/Dr_Dick_Dong_Stripper_Underworld/


That's all I got to blab about. So, thank you and have a dope a$$ weekend!

Regards, 
-M
